title: Engagement Celebration
description: A proposal celebrated at home over Valentine's weekend, worked entirely in red, pink, and white. A single-tier cake iced with a shell border and lettered “she said yes” stands on a mirrored crystal riser over red linen with champagne poured behind it. The rest of the house carries the same palette: a pink and magenta garland run the length of the kitchen ceiling with paper butterflies climbing the cabinets, a serving counter laid on a heart-print runner, and berry parfaits portioned into individual cups under a chalked sign.

alt.valentines-serving-counter.jpg: A white oval serving platter and spoon on a chalked Potatoes card, beside a red cheesecloth runner, rose accents, and a printed Happy Valentine's goblet
alt.parfait-cups.jpg: Individual berry and granola parfaits in clear cups with beaded spoons and heart cut-outs, set out on a counter under a chalked Parfaits sign
